segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר מה יש לאיש הישראלי לדאוג כשהוא מונח עם רגליו להדלת (היינו קודם פטירתו) עם זקן ופאות "וואס האט איוד ציא זארגען אז אר ליגטמיט דיא פיסציא דער טהיר מיט "א בארד אין פאות":
segments.en: Some days later a nobleman came to the inn, needed to relieve himself, went behind the inn — and forgot there his money-belt [beyya gortel] with sixty thousand gold coins. He drove on. Meanwhile the innkeeper also needed to relieve himself, went behind the inn, came upon exactly where the nobleman had been — and found the money-belt with the coins. He took it home and hid it in his chest. The nobleman, when he had traveled some distance, remembered he had forgotten the money-belt and returned to the inn. He asked the gentile servants if they had found it. They said they did not know. The innkeeper said: "I went out after you and found the belt with the money" — and returned it to him. The nobleman then wanted to continue his journey, but needed to relieve himself again, went behind the inn — and forgot the money-belt a second time. The innkeeper went out, found it again — and this time hid it very securely.
